positions.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning
positions.description:
+ Built Python and R wrapper of company’s machine learning library (developed in Scala/Spark), allowing data analysts
to work with most common tools (Pandas, scikit-learn) and environments (JupyterHub and RStudio).
+ Implemented Partial Dependence Plot algorithm, reducing computing time by 60% by optimizing Spark operations.
+ Replicated analysts’ on-prem environment in AWS, with JupyterHub, EMR, S3 and Livy.
+ Automated wrappers and environments (on-prem and cloud) testing using Docker and Jenkins.
+ Conducted and developed transition from monolithic to microservice architecture of machine learning tool.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Built system to label events from action camera videos while showing its corresponding
IMU sensor data, consisting on MySQL, Django, REST API and a Java desktop client.
+ Developed and deployed machine learning models to classify events from extreme sports
(surf, sky, snowboard) using IMU sensor data, obtaining 93% of accuracy in average on
test data by training GMM, SVM and HMM models.
+ Reduced event-labeling time of extreme sport sessions videos in 70% by using undertrained
models to recommend easily identifiable events to the labeling team.
+ Developed and deployed multi-class CNN model to classify audio events (laugh, screams,
cheering), obtaining 90% of accuracy on test data, model was trained in Tensorflow

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
+ Upgraded language and simulation framework of High Energy Physics experiment, from
FORTRAN and Geant3 to C++ and Geant4, enabling access to new tools like ROOT (C++
Framework) which facilitate data analysis.
+ Created a data processing pipeline, reducing in 70% the processing time, by executing the
tasks in parallel in a HPC cluster.
+ Performed statistical analysis on HEP experiment data to validate physicists models on hadronization processes of different particles (proton, pi+, pi-).

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Performance validation of an innovative data recovery algorithm by benchmarking against other industry standard algorithms on a NCFS simulation file system.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Built system to efficiently test prototypes of a photoelectric sensor (MCP-PMT), reducing the number of steps to completely test the device, by integrating the testing and measuring tools in LabView and C++ scripts.
